summary: NDR feed c087_span_crc is severely degraded: 64.5% packet loss from SPAN oversubscription (2.82 Gbps mirrored into 1 Gbps destination) plus 50,640 CRC/alignment errors on BROKER-A ingress. NDR is blind to majority of traffic and receiving corrupted frames.

findings.root_cause: Physical layer fault on link into BROKER-A port 1 (input): 50,640 damaged frames with CRC/alignment errors (0.4726% error rate, threshold 0.001%) indicates faulty cable, bad optic, or duplex mismatch
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR receives corrupted frames that are dropped by NIC/kernel before analysis; causes incomplete flows, broken reassembly, missed detections and wasted 10G tool capacity on unusable packets. Needs full payload and is sensitive to corruption.

recommended_fix.why: CRC/alignment errors are Layer-1; must replace cable/optic, clean fiber, check SFP type and force correct duplex/speed on both ends before any broker tuning. Retest error counters to <0.001%.

findings.root_cause: SPAN oversubscription and buffer drop at DIST-SW-02: 30,203,520 packets should be mirrored from Gi1/0/1 but SPAN destination Gi1/0/48 (1 Gbps) only sent 10,714,260. 2.82 Gbps offered into 1 Gbps port = 19,489,260 packets discarded on output (64.53% loss, avg 100% utilization, bursts higher)
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR missing 64.5% of packets/flows - catastrophic visibility gap. With both directions required, single-direction loss breaks flow reconstruction, IDS signatures and anomaly detection fail, attacker traffic easily missed.

params.suggested: passive TAP + packet broker with 10G capture or higher-capacity SPAN/ERSPAN with load balancing

recommended_fix.why: SPAN destination port cannot handle burst/mirrored rate and drops indiscriminately. A passive TAP provides lossless, full-duplex copy at line rate without switch CPU/buffer limits, restoring complete traffic to the 10G NDR.
